duas.title: Dua for Reward of Freeing Slaves (Masnun dua)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

Whoever says this dua ten times is like one who has freed four slaves from among the children of Ismaa'eel.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ‏.‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ، وَكُتِبَ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ، حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ عَمِلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Whoever says: "La ilaha illal-lah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahul- hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadir," one hundred times will get the same reward as given for manumitting ten slaves; and one hundred good deeds will be written in his accounts, and one hundred sins will be deducted from his accounts, and it (his saying) will be a shield for him from Satan on that day till night, and nobody will be able to do a better deed except the one who does more than he." [Bukhari No: 6403; Muslim No: 2693]

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness of Sins
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, A person who says 100 times a day -
duas.translation:
Glorified is Allah and praised is He.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, A person who says 100 times a day (dua mentioned above) It will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ‏.‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says, 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi,' one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea. [Bukhari: 6405]

duas.title: Dhikr for Forgiveness (Subhanallah Wa Bihamdihi Dua)
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah). And those are -
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to him, glory be to Allah the great.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi.'" [Bukhari: 6406]

duas.title: Powerful Dhikr Beloved to Allah (Masnun Dua)
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four. There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). And they are -
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu, wa Allahu 'Akbar
duas.translation:
How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. [1]

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The uttering of (these words) is dearer to me than anything over which the sun rises. [2]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنِ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ عُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ‏.‏ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بَأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ.‏ وَلاَ تُسَمِّيَنَّ غُلاَمَكَ يَسَارًا وَلاَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ نَجِيحًا وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقُولُ أَثَمَّ هُوَ فَلاَ يَكُونُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ‏." ‏‏ إِنَّمَا هُنَّ أَرْبَعٌ فَلاَ تَزِيدُنَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four: Subhan Allah (Hallowed be Allah), Al-Hamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa-Allah (There is no deity but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater). There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). And do not give these names to your servants: Yasar and Rabah and Najih and Aflah. [[1] Muslim: 2137 [2] Muslim: 2695]

duas.title: Benefits of Saying Subhan Allah
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Whoever says 100 times -
duas.translation:
How perfect Allah is.

One thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one thousand vices are blotted out.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported that his father told him that he had been in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Is one amongst you powerless to get one thousand virtues every day. Amongst those who had been sitting there, one asked: How one amongst us can get one thousand virtues every day? He said: Recite:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection) one hundred times for (by reciting them) one thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one thousand vices are blotted out. [Muslim: 2698]

duas.title: Benefits of Surah Ikhlas Daily Recitation
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّـهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. (1) Qul HuwAllahu 'Ahad. (2) Allahus-Samad. (3) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. (4) Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'ahad
duas.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (1) Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (3) He neither begets nor is born, (4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Sura Ikhlas: 1-4)

In a saheeh hadeeth, Mu'adh ibn Anas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever recites Surah Ikhlas 10 times, Allah will make a house for him in Paradise.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Surah Ikhlas Daily Recitation
how_to_perform.description: Reciting Surah Ikhlas every day brings Barakah and keeps your Iman strong. This surah is short but holds big rewards, and it is easy for every Muslim to read and remember in their daily Amal.
steps: Start your Fajr salah by reading surah ikhlas after Surah Fatiha for extra reward.
Before going to bed, recite surah al ikhlas three times for Allah’s protection.
When you feel scared or alone, softly say qul huwallahu ahad to find peace in your heart.
After every namaz, add surah ikhlas in your zikr allah to get more blessings in your day.
Teach your kids surah ikhlas in Arabic and Surah Ikhlas translation so they learn its meaning.

duas.title: Daily dua for planting a tree in Jannah
duas.translation:
How perfect Allah is, The Supreme, and I praise Him.

A palm tree will be planted in Paradise for him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏.‏ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Jabir narrated that: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever says: ‘Glory is to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His Praise (Subḥān Allāhil-Aẓīm, wa biḥamdih)’ a date-palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3464]

benefits.title: Benefits of Daily Dua for Planting a Tree in Jannah
benefits.description: This dua for Jannah helps a Muslim earn trees in Paradise and brings Allah’s praise and mercy closer, making every day full of hope and reward for the hereafter.
points: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem plants a tree in Jannah.
Jannat dua brings Barakah in Amal and keeps the heart soft with Allah’s zikr.
Subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi gives reward and wipes away small sins.
Daily dhikr with this masnun dua makes the path to Jannah easy for muslims.
Sincere use of this dua for success brings Allah’s help in both dunya and akhirah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Jannah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for jannah is a daily dhikr that plants a tree in Jannah, brings Barakah to your Amal, and fills your heart with hope for Allah’s mercy and reward in the next life.
points: After finishing salah, recite subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem for Jannah.
In free time, keep your tongue busy with this dua for jannah to earn reward.
While walking or working, say subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi for daily Barakah.
Before going to bed, end your day with this jannat dua for forgiveness and success.
When feeling sad, use this dua for jannah to fill your heart with hope and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Planting a Tree in Jannah
how_to_perform.description: This dua for Jannah is easy to say and brings you closer to Allah’s mercy. Recite it daily to plant trees in Jannah and fill your book of Amal with good deeds and Barakah.
steps: Begin your morning by saying subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem softly.
After every salah, repeat this dua for jannah to grow your rewards in the hereafter.
While doing daily work, let your lips move with subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi.
Teach your family the meaning of subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem in urdu.
Before going to bed, quietly say this muslim prayer to end your day with zikr allah.

duas.title: Dua for Jannah (Lahaula Walaquwata)
duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah
duas.translation:
There is no might nor power except with Allah.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “O 'Abdullah ibn Qays! Shall I not inform you of one of the treasures of Paradise? ” I said, "Surely, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Say it." - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَكُنَّا إِذَا عَلَوْنَا كَبَّرْنَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، فَإِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا، وَلَكِنْ تَدْعُونَ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَى عَلَىَّ وَأَنَا أَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا‏.‏ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Musa: We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and whenever we ascended a high place, we used to say Takbir (in a loud voice). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be kind to yourselves, for you are not calling upon a deaf or an absent one, but You are calling an All-Hearer, and an All-Seer." Then he came to me as I was reciting silently, "La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." He said, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say: La haul a walaquwata illa bil-lah, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise." Or he said, "Shall I tell you a word which is one of the treasures of Paradise? It is: La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." [Bukhari: 6384]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Jannah (Lahaula Walaquwata)
benefits.description: This jannat dua reminds every Muslim that all strength comes from Allah alone, bringing hope, reward, and help in every hard time for those who trust in His power.
points: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah in arabic opens doors to Jannah for muslims.
This powerful dua brings Allah’s help in tough times and keeps Iman strong.
Lahaula walaquwata makes sins easy to leave and Amal easy to do for Allah.
Jannat dua gives peace in the heart and keeps a muslim safe from pride.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah ki fazilat brings reward in both dunya and akhirah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Jannat Dua (Lahaula Walaquwata)
when_to_recite.description: This jannat dua reminds us that all power and help comes from Allah, bringing Barakah, strength, and hope for Jannah when recited in times of need and daily life.
points: After salah, repeat la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for reward and Jannah.
When facing hard times, use this powerful dua to seek Allah’s help and strength.
In your daily zikr, add la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for Barakah and Iman.
While feeling weak or tired, say this jannat dua to remember Allah’s power.
Before going to bed, end your day with la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for peace.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Jannat Dua (Lahaula Walaquwata)
how_to_perform.description: Reciting this jannat dua reminds you that all power comes from Allah alone. It is a simple but powerful dua for jannah that brings Barakah and helps you stay strong in your Iman every day.
steps: Start your day by saying la hawla wala quwwata illa billah in arabic with full heart.
When you feel weak or tired, softly repeat this powerful dua to seek Allah’s help.
After every namaz, add la hawla wala quwwata illa billah to your zikr allah for more reward.
Teach your kids the meaning of la hawla wala quwwata illa billah in urdu so they learn this muslim prayer.
While facing any hard time, quietly say lahaula walaquwata to keep your trust in Allah.

duas.title: Dua of all praise for Allah (Masnoon Dua)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, Allahu 'Akbar kabeeran, walhamdu lillaahi katheeran, SubhaanAllahi Rabbil-'aalameen, laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa biilaahil-'Azeezil-Hakeem
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without any partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Praising Allah (Masnoon Dua)
benefits.description: This dua praising Allah brings a muslim closer to Him, filling the heart with thankfulness and reminding us of Allah’s greatness, mercy, and power in every part of daily life.
points: Allah’s help comes to the one who says la ilaha illalahu with full Iman.
The words allahu akbar and alhamdulillah bring Barakah and peace in Amal.
Subhanallah meaning reminds muslims to keep hearts clean from bad things.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning gives strength in hard times.
Masnoon dua like this keeps a muslim’s zikr allah strong in every Salah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Praising Allah
when_to_recite.description: This dua praising Allah is a masnoon dua that fills your heart with Iman and Barakah, reminding you of Allah’s greatness and mercy in every moment, bringing peace and reward to your daily Amal.
points: After finishing salah, use this dua praising Allah to thank Him for His blessings.
While walking on the road, remember Allah with la ilaha illalahu and feel His nearness.
In times of hardship, recite la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for strength and help.
When you see something amazing, say subhanallah meaning Allah is perfect in all ways.
During morning and evening azkar, repeat this masnoon dua for daily Barakah and protection.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of all praise for Allah
how_to_perform.description: This dua praising Allah is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and peace to your heart. Reciting these words like la ilaha illalahu, allahu akbar, alhamdulillah, and subhanallah helps you remember Allah’s greatness and thank Him for His blessings every day.
steps: Start your day by reciting this dua praising allah after Fajr salah to fill your heart with Iman.
When you feel happy or get any good news, say allahu akbar and alhamdulillah in arabic.
During your walks on road or while sitting alone, softly repeat subhanallah meaning and la hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning.
Before going to bed, recite this masnoon dua to thank Allah for all His gifts and mercy.
After finishing your namaz, use this islamic dua to keep your zikr allah strong and your Amal pure.

duas.title: Dua after Accepting Islam (Masnun Dua)
duas.introduction: Whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte -
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wa 'aafinee warzuqnee
duas.translation:
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.

Another narration of Muslim says, "These will combine everything in this world and the Hereafter for you."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Malik Ashaja'i reported on the authority of his father that whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness and provide me sustenance." [Muslim: 2697]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua after Accepting Islam
benefits.description: This dua after accepting Islam helps a new muslim ask Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq, making the start of their Iman journey full of hope and Barakah.
points: Allahummaghfirli warhamni brings Allah’s forgiveness and covers old sins.
Hidayat ki dua helps a muslim stay on the right path with strong Iman.
Rizq ki dua in this masnoon dua opens doors for halal food and daily needs.
Allah’s mercy and safety come to the one who makes this dua after salah.
Powerful dua for everything keeps a muslim’s heart close to Allah always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Accepting Islam
when_to_recite.description: This dua after accepting Islam is a masnoon dua asking Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq, making your Iman strong and your Amal full of Barakah in every step of your new Muslim life.
points: Right after accepting Islam, recite this dua after accepting islam for Allah’s mercy.
During sujood in salah, ask Allah with allahummaghfirli warhamni wahdini warzuqni.
After every salah, make this dua for forgiveness and rizq to keep your heart clean.
When feeling lost, use this hidayat ki dua to seek guidance and Barakah from Allah.
In times of need, repeat this powerful dua for everything and trust Allah’s plan.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after accepting Islam
how_to_perform.description: This dua after accepting Islam is a masnoon dua that asks Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq. It is a simple and powerful islamic dua every new Muslim and believer should use daily to keep their Iman and Amal strong.
steps: After saying shahada, raise your hands and recite allahummaghfirli warhamni wahdini warzuqni.
When you finish your salah, quietly say this dua for forgiveness from Allah and ask for Barakah.
If you feel lost or need help, use this dua for guidance and rizq ki dua in your own words.
Before going to bed, repeat this masnoon dua to seek Allah’s mercy and maghfirat ki dua.
During sujood in namaz, whisper this sujood dua to ask for safety and daily rizq from Allah.

duas.title: Most Powerful Dhikr and Dua in Islam

benefits.title: Benefits of Powerful Dua and Dhikr (Alhamdulillah)
benefits.description: Saying Alhamdulillah fills the heart with shukr, brings peace, and keeps a muslim close to Allah, making every moment full of Barakah and hope in daily life.
points: Alhamdulillah meaning teaches a muslim to thank Allah in every Amal.
This powerful dua and dhikr brings Allah’s mercy and removes sadness.
Zikr allah with Alhamdulillah keeps Iman strong in all times of life.
Saying Alhamdulillah for everything brings more rizq and good in the home.
Best dua for everything helps muslims remember Allah after every Salah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Powerful Dua and Dhikr
when_to_recite.description: This powerful dua and dhikr, Alhamdulillah, fills your heart with shukar and brings Barakah in every moment, reminding you to thank Allah for all things, big or small, and making your Iman strong every day.
points: After finishing any meal, say Alhamdulillah to thank Allah for His rizq and blessings.
When waking up in the morning, start your day with Alhamdulillah for a fresh start.
During times of happiness, use this powerful dua and dhikr to show your shukar to Allah.
After completing any good deed, praise Allah with Alhamdulillah for Barakah in your Amal.
In moments of hardship, remember Alhamdulillah meaning and trust Allah’s wisdom always.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Powerful Dua and Dhikr
how_to_perform.description: Saying Alhamdulillah is the most powerful dua and dhikr in Islam, filling your heart with shukar and bringing you closer to Allah. This simple word, Alhamdulillah, means all praise is for Allah and should be used daily by every Muslim.
steps: After every namaz, softly say Alhamdulillah in Arabic to thank Allah for His gifts.
When you eat or drink, remember to say Alhamdulillah for everything you have.
If you feel happy or safe, use this powerful dua and dhikr to show your shukar Alhamdulillah.
While sitting with family or friends, quietly repeat Alhamdulillah meaning in your heart.
Before going to bed, end your day with this best dhikr allah to keep your Iman strong.

duas.title: Powerful Dhikr That Lasts Forever in Jannah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhaanAllah, walhamdu lillaah, wa Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllah, wa Allahu 'Akbar, Laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.reference: Musnad-e Ahmad (no. 513) (Ahmad Shakir, ed.) and its chain of narration is authentic. See Majma'uz-Zawa'id 1/297. Ibn Hajar mentions it in Bulughul-Maram saying that Ibn Hibban and Al-Hakim considered it authentic.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dhikr and Dua That Lasts Forever in Jannah
benefits.description: This dhikr and dua fills the heart with Iman, brings Allah’s mercy, and gives rewards that stay forever in Jannah, making every muslim’s Amal strong and full of Barakah.
points: Subhanallah meaning helps a muslim keep the tongue clean with Allah’s zikr.
La ilaha illallah in this dhikr and dua brings forgiveness for many old sins.
Alhamdulillah meaning fills the home with shukr and Allah’s blessings.
Allahu Akbar meaning gives courage and hope in every hard time of life.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning brings help from Allah in all Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dhikr and Dua
when_to_recite.description: This dhikr and dua brings endless Barakah and reward, filling your heart with Iman and shukar, and making your tongue busy with the best zikr allah that lasts forever in Jannah and every day in this world.
points: After salah, fill your time with dhikr and dua by saying subhanallahi walhamdulillahi wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar.
While walking alone, remember Allah with la ilaha illallah and feel His nearness.
In times of worry, repeat la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for strength and peace.
During morning and evening azkar, use this best dhikr for daily Barakah and protection.
When you see something beautiful, say subhanallah meaning Allah is perfect in all ways.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dhikr and Dua That Lasts Forever in Jannah
how_to_perform.description: This dhikr and dua is called the best dhikr, and it brings endless Barakah in this life and Jannah. Reciting subhanallahi walhamdulillahi wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar and la hawla wala quwwata illa billah fills your heart with Iman and keeps your Amal pure every day.
steps: After every salah, recite subhanallah in arabic, alhamdulillah in arabic, and allahu akbar in arabic.
When you feel weak or tired, softly say la hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning.
While walking or working, repeat la ilaha illallah and subhanallah meaning in your heart.
Before going to bed, use this dhikr and dua to thank Allah and ask for His help.
In times of worry, quietly say subhanallahi walhamdulillahi wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar.

duas.title: Tasbeeh of the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.introduction: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As (RA), I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) counting the glorification of Allah on fingers. Ibn Qudamah (RA) said in his version: "With his right hands".
